consent.heading: Screen capture
consent.captured: The agent captures only the Diablo II: Resurrected game window, and only while the game runs and you have allowed it. It never captures the desktop or another window.
consent.sent: The agent sends the characters on the character selection screen (name, class, level, mode, ladder, era and unlocked difficulties) and the screen the game shows.
consent.neverLeaves: The captured images never leave this PC. They are kept in memory only.
consent.allowed: Capture is allowed on this PC.
consent.withdrawn: Capture is off. The agent reads nothing.
consent.notSaved: Could not save your choice. Try again.

telemetry.heading: Diagnostics
telemetry.noticeProduction: Diagnostics help the maintainers follow a problem. They carry ids, the generated game name, the screen the agent recognised, how the read went and timings. They never carry names or text read from the game, and never an image.
telemetry.noticeFull: This test build sends detailed diagnostics for debugging: also the character names and the text the agent read from the game window. This detail exists in staging and preview builds only. Images are never sent.
telemetry.effect: The change applies at once. Heartbeats and everything matchmaking needs are sent either way.
telemetry.off: Diagnostics are off. The agent sends none.
telemetry.notSaved: Could not save your choice. Try again.
telemetry.unreadable: Could not read your diagnostics setting. The switch is shown as on; turn it off if you do not want to send them.

refused.no-modifier: Use Ctrl or Alt with the key.
refused.needs-ctrl-or-alt: Use Ctrl or Alt with the key; Shift alone is not enough.
refused.reserved: That combination is already used by Windows or every program (such as Ctrl+C, Alt+F4 or the Windows key). Pick another.
refused.confirming-key: Enter, Tab, Space, Escape and Backspace cannot be hotkeys.
refused.unsupported-key: Use a letter, a digit or F1 to F12 (for example Ctrl+Shift+F).
refused.not-saved: Could not save the hotkey. Try again.
